messages:
maya: quick design sync — proposing a new "snap anchors" affordance in the time range picker so PMs can pin canonical comparison points (e.g., deploy boundary, business event) and compare p95/heatmap slices side-by-side. attaching rough problem statement + a11y concerns.

leo: curious — can you call out the main user goals? is this mostly for ad-hoc debugging or saved dashboards?

maya: both. primary: 1) spot regressions at specific events (deploys/releases) 2) make it easy to compare identical windows across days for p95 drift. secondary: make sharing a view easier (deep link to anchor).

sam: quick visual note — when we align to anchors, our current heatmap aggregation (variable bucket widths) creates aliasing where p95 looks like it moved due to bucket boundaries. we should either align buckets to anchors or show bucket boundaries on hover.

tia: accessibility nits: whatever UI we add needs keyboard-accessible anchor creation + an aria-live region announcing when the pinned anchor is applied (so screen reader users know context changed). also ensure anchor icons have >= 4.5:1 contrast.

aria: mock link: https://figma.com/s/anchor-timepicker (WIP). proposed microcopy: instead of "Pin range" use "Create anchor" and for the tooltip "Anchor this time window for quick comparison". For sampling toggles — suggest label: "Sampling: adaptive (recommended)" with a short tooltip describing bias.

leo: copy nit noted. for defaults: I'd prefer "adaptive" as default for hosted users, but explicit "full" scan option in enterprise plans (with cost warning).

sam: backend perf reality — full-scan is expensive. current sampling is pyramid + reservoir approach; we'll need an opt-in for full retrieval. quick pseudocode of what we run now if helpful:
```
# reservoir sampling per time-bucket
for bucket in buckets:
  reservoir = []
  for req in bucket.stream():
    if len(reservoir) < k: reservoir.append(req)
    else: replace_idx = rand(0, count)
    count += 1
```
This means p95 from a sample may jitter; recommend we show a tiny badge: "sampled" and on hover show sample rate.

tia: +1 to the "sampled" badge. also keyboard: how do you create an anchor? double-click? we need clear affordance and focus order: open timepicker -> create anchor -> anchor receives focus -> announce.

aria: design thought: anchors are ephemeral by default (session-scoped). allow 'save as comparison' which persists and can be shared. Visual treatment: small vertical marker across heatmap with accessible label ("Anchor — deploy 2025-03-05 14:20 UTC"). color suggestions: #0B66D2 for marker, but tia flagged contrast — maybe darker #084E9E.

maya: good—session-scoped default makes sense. question for eng: can we surface per-route sampling percentage in the latency card (so product teams can see sampling bias at glance)?

leo: we can expose a `sampling_rate` field from the service. low effort to surface it in the UI as a percent. still need backend to report whether bucket-level reservoir was used.

sam: we'll add `sampling_rate` and `sampling_strategy` to the metrics event. FYI this will inflate telemetry slightly. we should gate in Dedicated/Private until infra knows cost.

ux-bot: A11Y checklist:
• Anchor creation reachable by keyboard (Enter/Space).
• Newly created anchor announced via aria-live: "Anchor created: <label>".
• Marker color passes 4.5:1 against chart background.
• Sampling badge has descriptive text + tooltip.
• Focus order: timepicker -> anchor list -> heatmap.

maya: tia / aria — can you pair on a concise a11y PR for the marker contrast + aria-live copy? also aria, can you try the copy variants: "Create anchor" vs "Pin snapshot" in the mock?

aria: happy to. I'll mock both and post frames with keyboard flow.

tia: I'll run the contrast checks and propose final color tokens. passing tests is priority.

leo: small UX perf ask — when switching anchors, do we stream incremental data or re-run full requests? incremental streaming keeps UI snappy.

sam: incremental streaming possible for sampled views — we'll stream deltas and show a loading shimmer for missing buckets. full-scan still takes longer. we'll add an API flag `anchor_mode=stream|full`.

maya: ok team — plan: aria + tia deliver updated mocks + copy by EOD tomorrow; eng (sam/leo) to confirm API flags and telemetry scope by EOD as well. I'll schedule a quick 20m review Wed 10am. thanks all :heart:

leo: can we add a small in-dashboard callout explaining "why results may differ" when sampling active? simple sentence + learn more link.

aria: yes — proposed copy: "Results may be based on sampled data to keep queries fast. Click to see sample rate and full-scan options."

maya: perfect. dropping meeting invite now.

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: many)
